name: Meadowbloom Dryad: [Class Bonus] whenever an ally enters, buff counter on target ally
notes: Meadowbloom Dryad is TERA. The starting champion's CardID is patched directly to Silvie, Loved by All -- both TAMER (satisfies the Class Bonus) and TERA (unlocks element access) at once. The trigger (FieldAfterAdd, GameLogic.php ~8126) fires for ANY ally entering, including Meadowbloom Dryad itself: when it resolves as the very first ally on either field, it is the only entry in the target-ally search, so the engine auto-applies the buff counter without a choice decision (count($allyTargets) === 1 skips the MZCHOOSE branch) -- a simpler and equally valid way to exercise the trigger than materializing a second ally afterward. Confirmed via its own Counters.buff = 1. Only the Class Bonus trigger is covered; Preserve (returning from the material deck on materialize) is a separate, out-of-scope mechanic.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] Whenever CARDNAME or another ally enters the field under your control, put a buff counter on target ally.
